title: Run the brain packet experiment
body:
Run the pre-registered Wizard-of-Oz A/B/C/R experiment in `evals/woz/` (operator 2026-10-27): freeze base SHAs, contracts, escaped-defect checklist and randomisation before the first run; prereg thresholds win over ADR 0002; record results and decide brain v2 scope from them.
Acceptance: frozen manifest committed before runs; all arms run or are reported invalid with reasons; results table and threshold verdicts recorded.
